description: Read the private live preview for this project and environment: its link, state, saved and applied version, expires_at, failure and ready_to_show. The link is for the user: hand it over when ready_to_show is true. Private means: keep it out of source files, notes and logs. The link is valid for at most 24 hours from creation. If the start failed, failure carries a code and next_step: follow it instead of waiting.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.
